items.question: Rates of homicide, robbery, property crime, motor vehicle theft, and violent crime, for each state from 2024 to present, ideally monthly

today.sql:
WITH state_pop AS (
  SELECT a.state, s.year,
    SUM(a.population * COALESCE(c.months_reported, 12) / 12.0) AS adj_population
  FROM agencies a
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness c ON c.ori = a.ori AND c.year = a.year
  WHERE a.year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 AND a.population > 0
  GROUP BY a.state, s.year
),
homicide AS (
  SELECT state, year, month, SUM(victim_count) AS count
  FROM summary_victim_state_monthly
  WHERE ucr_offense_code = '09A' AND year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
  GROUP BY state, year, month
),
robbery AS (
  SELECT state, year, month, SUM(offense_count) AS count
  FROM summary_state_monthly
  WHERE ucr_offense_code = '120' AND year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
  GROUP BY state, year, month
),
property_crime AS (
  SELECT state, year, month, SUM(offense_count) AS count
  FROM summary_state_monthly
  WHERE ucr_offense_code IN ('200','220','23A','23B','23C','23D','23E','23F','23G','23H','240')
    AND year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
  GROUP BY state, year, month
),
mvt AS (
  SELECT state, year, month, SUM(offense_count) AS count
  FROM summary_state_monthly
  WHERE ucr_offense_code = '240' AND year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
  GROUP BY state, year, month
),
violent_crime AS (
  SELECT state, year, month, SUM(victim_count) AS count
  FROM summary_victim_state_monthly
  WHERE ucr_offense_code IN ('09A','11A','11B','11C','13A') AND year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
  GROUP BY state, year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT state, year, month, SUM(offense_count) AS count
  FROM summary_state_monthly
  WHERE ucr_offense_code = '120' AND year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
  GROUP BY state, year, month
)
SELECT sp.state, sp.year, COALESCE(h.month,r.month,pc.month,m.month,v.month) AS month,
  ROUND(COALESCE(h.count,0) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(sp.adj_population, 0), 2) AS homicide_rate,
  ROUND(COALESCE(r.count,0) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(sp.adj_population, 0), 2) AS robbery_rate,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pc.count,0) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(sp.adj_population, 0), 2) AS property_crime_rate,
  ROUND(COALESCE(m.count,0) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(sp.adj_population, 0), 2) AS mvt_rate,
  ROUND(COALESCE(v.count,0) * 100000.0 / NULLIF(sp.adj_population, 0), 2) AS violent_crime_rate
FROM state_pop sp
LEFT JOIN homicide h ON h.state = sp.state AND h.year = sp.year
LEFT JOIN robbery r ON r.state = sp.state AND r.year = sp.year AND r.month = h.month
LEFT JOIN property_crime pc ON pc.state = sp.state AND pc.year = sp.year AND pc.month = h.month
LEFT JOIN mvt m ON m.state = sp.state AND m.year = sp.year AND m.month = h.month
LEFT JOIN violent_crime v ON v.state = sp.state AND v.year = sp.year AND v.month = h.month
WHERE sp.adj_population > 0
ORDER BY sp.state, sp.year, COALESCE(h.month,r.month,pc.month,m.month,v.month) LIMIT 1000

today.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'New York City, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0303000' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
),
series_counts AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, 'murder' AS offense_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, tp.place_key, MAX(a.population) AS population, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.place_key = tp.place_key AND y.year = 2026
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year, tp.place_key
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) = 12 THEN ROUND(100000.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.place_key = 'place_1' AND sc.offense_key = 'murder' THEN sc.reported_count END), 0) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END), 0), 1) ELSE NULL END AS new_york_city_ny_murders_rate_per_100k
FROM place_reporting AS pr LEFT JOIN series_counts AS sc ON sc.year = pr.year AND sc.place_key = pr.place_key
GROUP BY pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

items.question: Aggravated assault rate in White Plains, NY from 2021 to 2025

today.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
),
series_counts AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, 'aggravated_assault' AS offense_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '13A'
    AND s.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, tp.place_key, MAX(a.population) AS population, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.place_key = tp.place_key AND y.year = 2026
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year, tp.place_key
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) = 12 THEN ROUND(100000.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.place_key = 'place_1' AND sc.offense_key = 'aggravated_assault' THEN sc.reported_count END), 0) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END), 0), 1) ELSE NULL END AS white_plains_ny_aggravated_assaults_rate_per_100k
FROM place_reporting AS pr LEFT JOIN series_counts AS sc ON sc.year = pr.year AND sc.place_key = pr.place_key
GROUP BY pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

items.question: show rolling 12-month totals by age group by month from December 2022 to December 2025

today.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT s.year, s.month, d.age_group, SUM(d.victim_count) AS victim_count
  FROM summary_victim_demographics d
  JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly s ON s.ori = d.ori AND s.year = d.year AND s.ucr_offense_code = d.ucr_offense_code
  WHERE d.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025 AND d.ucr_offense_code IN ('09A','11A','11B','11C','13A','100')
  GROUP BY s.year, s.month, d.age_group
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT DATE('2022-12-01') AS start_date, DATE('2025-12-31') AS end_date
),
spine (year, month) AS (
  SELECT 2021, 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN month = 12 THEN year + 1 ELSE year END,
         CASE WHEN month = 12 THEN 1 ELSE month + 1 END
  FROM spine
  WHERE (year < 2025 OR (year = 2025 AND month < 12))
),
monthly_dense AS (
  SELECT s.year, s.month, m.age_group, COALESCE(m.victim_count, 0) AS victim_count
  FROM spine s
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.year = s.year AND m.month = s.month
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT year, month, age_group, victim_count,
    SUM(victim_count) OVER (PARTITION BY age_group ORDER BY year, month ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_12m
  FROM monthly_dense
)
SELECT year, month, age_group, rolling_12m
FROM rolling

items.question: Murders related to narcotics in Yuma in the past 5 years

today.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Yuma, AZ' AS place_label, 'AZ0140500' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT s.year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY s.year
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.year = y.year
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year
),
annual_counts AS (
  SELECT s.year, SUM(s.victim_count) AS murders
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  GROUP BY s.year
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN pr.months_reported = 12 OR (pr.year = 2026 AND (COALESCE(pr.months_reported, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(pr.summary_months_reported, 0) > 0)) THEN COALESCE(ac.murders, 0) ELSE NULL END AS murders
FROM place_reporting AS pr
LEFT JOIN annual_counts AS ac ON ac.year = pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

Historical counts are left blank unless the agency reported all 12 months; current-year partial counts remain visible when summary data exists and are disclosed as partial. Months reported are inferred from months containing reported offenses, so this conservative rule can suppress a complete small-agency year with a genuinely offense-free month. WITH requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2018), (2019), (2020), (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025), (2026)),

  FROM summary_clearance_detail scd INDEXED BY idx_scd_ori_year

    AND scd.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026

    AND s.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026
  GROUP BY s.year

items.question: Compare the rape clearance rate for the Denver Police Department against 3 agencies of similar size.

today.sql:
WITH
target_years AS (
  SELECT 2021 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 740209 AS population
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2022 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 705264 AS population
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2023 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 712222 AS population
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2024 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 722031 AS population
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2025 AS year, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 733212 AS population
),
peer_selected AS (
  SELECT 'TN0190100' AS ori, 'NASHVILLE, TN' AS place_label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'DCMPD0000' AS ori, 'WASHINGTON, DC' AS place_label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'KY0568000' AS ori, 'LOUISVILLE, KY' AS place_label
),
target_data AS (
  SELECT 1 AS available
  FROM target_years ty
  CROSS JOIN summary_clearance_type target_probe INDEXED BY idx_sct_ori_year
  WHERE target_probe.ori = ty.ori
    AND target_probe.year = ty.year
    AND target_probe.ucr_offense_code IN ('11A', '11B', '11C')
  LIMIT 1
),
peer_candidates AS (
  SELECT ps.ori AS ori, ps.place_label AS place_label
  FROM peer_selected ps
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_data)
),
selected_agencies AS (
  SELECT 'Denver Police Department' AS place_label, ty.ori AS ori, ty.year AS effective_year FROM target_years ty
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_data)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pc.place_label AS place_label, pc.ori AS ori, NULL AS effective_year FROM peer_candidates pc
),
clearances AS (
  SELECT sct.year, sa.place_label, sa.ori,
    SUM(sct.total_offenses) AS total_offenses,
    SUM(sct.cleared_by_arrest) AS cleared_by_arrest,
    SUM(sct.cleared_exceptional) AS cleared_exceptional
  FROM selected_agencies sa
  CROSS JOIN summary_clearance_type sct INDEXED BY idx_sct_ori_year
  WHERE sct.ori = sa.ori
    AND (sa.effective_year IS NULL OR sa.effective_year = sct.year)
    AND sct.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
    AND sct.ucr_offense_code IN ('11A', '11B', '11C')
  GROUP BY sct.year, sa.place_label, sa.ori
)
SELECT year, place_label, ori,
  total_offenses,
  cleared_by_arrest,
  cleared_exceptional,
  ROUND(100.0 * (cleared_by_arrest + cleared_exceptional) / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS clearance_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * cleared_by_arrest / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS arrest_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * cleared_exceptional / NULLIF(total_offenses, 0), 1) AS exceptional_rate_pct
FROM clearances
ORDER BY year, place_label
LIMIT 1000

items.question: Allentown murder rate 2026

today.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Allentown, PA' AS place_label, 'PA0390100' AS ori, 2026 AS effective_year
),
offense_counts_1 AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND s.year = 2026
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2026)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, tp.place_key, MAX(a.population) AS population, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.place_key = tp.place_key AND y.year = 2026
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year, tp.place_key
)
,observed_months AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, s.year, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.month) AS activity_months, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ori) AS activity_oris
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year IN (SELECT year FROM requested_years)
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key, s.year
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) = 12 THEN ROUND(100000.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oc1.place_key = 'place_1' THEN oc1.reported_count END), 0) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END), 0), 1) ELSE NULL END AS allentown_pa_murders_rate_per_100k,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) AS meta_place_1_months_reported,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END) AS meta_place_1_population,
  MAX(CASE WHEN om.place_key = 'place_1' THEN om.activity_months END) AS meta_place_1_activity_months,
  MAX(CASE WHEN om.place_key = 'place_1' THEN om.activity_oris END) AS meta_place_1_activity_oris
FROM place_reporting AS pr
LEFT JOIN offense_counts_1 AS oc1 ON oc1.year = pr.year AND oc1.place_key = pr.place_key
LEFT JOIN observed_months AS om ON om.year = pr.year AND om.place_key = pr.place_key
GROUP BY pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

today.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'White Plains, NY' AS place_label, 'NY0590200' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
),
offense_counts_1 AS (
  SELECT s.year, tp.place_key, SUM(s.victim_count) AS reported_count
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_victim_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_svcm_ori
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
    AND s.ucr_offense_code = '13A'
    AND s.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  GROUP BY s.year, tp.place_key
),
requested_years(year) AS (VALUES (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)),
current_year_reporting AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, COUNT(DISTINCT s.month) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year = 2026
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key
),
place_reporting AS (
  SELECT y.year, tp.place_key, MAX(a.population) AS population, MAX(c.months_reported) AS months_reported, MAX(cyr.summary_months_reported) AS summary_months_reported
  FROM requested_years AS y
  CROSS JOIN target_places AS tp
  LEFT JOIN agencies AS a ON a.ori = tp.ori AND a.year = y.year AND a.population > 0
  LEFT JOIN nibrs_agency_completeness AS c INDEXED BY idx_nac_ori_year
    ON c.ori = tp.ori AND c.year = y.year
  LEFT JOIN current_year_reporting AS cyr ON cyr.place_key = tp.place_key AND y.year = 2026
  WHERE tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = y.year
  GROUP BY y.year, tp.place_key
)
,observed_months AS (
  SELECT tp.place_key, s.year, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.month) AS activity_months, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ori) AS activity_oris
  FROM target_places AS tp
  CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
  WHERE s.ori = tp.ori AND s.year IN (SELECT year FROM requested_years)
    AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
  GROUP BY tp.place_key, s.year
)
SELECT pr.year,
  CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) = 12 THEN ROUND(100000.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oc1.place_key = 'place_1' THEN oc1.reported_count END), 0) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END), 0), 1) ELSE NULL END AS white_plains_ny_aggravated_assaults_rate_per_100k,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.months_reported END) AS meta_place_1_months_reported,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pr.place_key = 'place_1' THEN pr.population END) AS meta_place_1_population,
  MAX(CASE WHEN om.place_key = 'place_1' THEN om.activity_months END) AS meta_place_1_activity_months,
  MAX(CASE WHEN om.place_key = 'place_1' THEN om.activity_oris END) AS meta_place_1_activity_oris
FROM place_reporting AS pr
LEFT JOIN offense_counts_1 AS oc1 ON oc1.year = pr.year AND oc1.place_key = pr.place_key
LEFT JOIN observed_months AS om ON om.year = pr.year AND om.place_key = pr.place_key
GROUP BY pr.year
ORDER BY pr.year
LIMIT 1000

items.question: chicago murder clearances by clearance type in 2025

today.sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT scd.year AS year,
    SUM(scd.total_offenses) AS total_offenses,
    SUM(scd.cleared_by_arrest) AS cleared_by_arrest,
    SUM(scd.cleared_A) AS cleared_a,
    SUM(scd.cleared_B) AS cleared_b,
    SUM(scd.cleared_C) AS cleared_c,
    SUM(scd.cleared_D) AS cleared_d,
    SUM(scd.cleared_E) AS cleared_e
  FROM summary_clearance_detail scd INDEXED BY idx_scd_ori_year
  WHERE scd.ucr_offense_code = '09A'
    AND scd.year = 2025
    AND scd.ori IN ('ILCPD0000')
  GROUP BY scd.year
)
SELECT year, clearance_type, offenses FROM (
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Cleared by arrest' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_by_arrest AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Death of offender' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_a AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Prosecution declined' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_b AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'In custody elsewhere' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_c AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Victim refused to cooperate' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_d AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Juvenile, no custody' AS clearance_type, t.cleared_e AS offenses FROM totals t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.year AS year, 'Not cleared' AS clearance_type, t.total_offenses - (t.cleared_by_arrest + t.cleared_a + t.cleared_b + t.cleared_c + t.cleared_d + t.cleared_e) AS offenses FROM totals t
)
ORDER BY year, CASE clearance_type WHEN 'Cleared by arrest' THEN 1 WHEN 'Death of offender' THEN 2 WHEN 'Prosecution declined' THEN 3 WHEN 'In custody elsewhere' THEN 4 WHEN 'Victim refused to cooperate' THEN 5 WHEN 'Juvenile, no custody' THEN 6 WHEN 'Not cleared' THEN 7 END
LIMIT 1000
today.response:
Every clearance category for Murders in Chicago, IL for the requested year, with uncleared offenses shown as their own category so the parts sum to the reported total. FBI clearance means cleared by arrest or exceptional means; it is not a conviction. Recent NIBRS data may be incomplete.

Clearance note: FBI clearance means cleared by arrest or exceptional means; it is not the same as conviction or prosecution.

Period: 2025.

items.question: Denver vehicle burglaries per month since 2018

today.sql:
WITH target_places AS (
  SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2018 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2019 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2020 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2021 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2022 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2023 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2024 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2025 AS effective_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'place_1' AS place_key, 'Denver, CO' AS place_label, 'CODPD0000' AS ori, 2026 AS effective_year
)
SELECT s.year, s.month, SUM(s.offense_count) AS offenses
FROM target_places AS tp
CROSS JOIN summary_city_monthly AS s INDEXED BY idx_scm_ori_year
WHERE s.ucr_offense_code = '23F'
  AND s.state = 'CO'
  AND s.year >= 2018
  AND s.ori = tp.ori
  AND (tp.effective_year IS NULL OR tp.effective_year = s.year)
GROUP BY s.year, s.month
ORDER BY s.year, s.month
LIMIT 1000
today.response:
This returns reported offenses for Denver, CO for the requested years. Recent monthly NIBRS data may be incomplete because agencies submit on different schedules.

Returned period: January 2018-September 2026.

The 2026 figures cover January-September 2026.
